issues_found.description: Authoritative OvPhysX failure: first-step displacement is 3.8796591114139645 m versus reported expected ballistic displacement 0.00545 m; peak linear speed is 293.85043910371166 m/s. Later settling cannot override this hard failure.

The zero-drop validation scene adds drawer translation (0,-0.954371452331543,0), while the authored drawer and cabinet have identity transforms and the preserved Z-prismatic joint has zero local anchors on both endpoints. This introduces a transverse initial constraint mismatch. It is a likely contributor to the discontinuity, not a proven sole cause.
The task and issue packet provide rendered_frames:[] and no render-frame receipt. No simulation images are available for direct inspection; visual plausibility cannot be assessed.
